name: Level_1 - Task_8
description: Evaluate the equilibrium cell volume of bulk Copper at 600 K using molecular dynamics. Start with a conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Copper (a = 3.615 Å) and replicate it into a 3 × 3 × 3 supercell (108 atoms). The MACE-MP-0 foundation model should be used as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe interatomic interactions. Initialize the atomic velocities for a temperature of 600 K and zero out the center-of-mass momentum. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the isothermal-isobaric (NPT) ensemble with a target temperature of 600 K, an external pressure of 1.01325 bar, a timestep of 1.0 fs, a thermostat time constant of 25 fs, and a barostat factor of 2e6 GPa × fs². Perform an initial equilibration phase of 2,000 steps, followed immediately by a 1,000-step production run. Record the instantaneous cell volume at every step of the production phase and compute the average. Return the average cell volume as a floating-point value in Å³.
